text.tspan: Inside one network vs between networks
laptop ↔ phone: direct, never leaves home
Inside one network (home, office floor, VPC subnet)
devices talk directly, through a switch or Wi-Fi AP
routers pass each packet on, hop by hop
The internet = independent networks that all speak IP and swap routes with BGP · the web (HTTP) is one app on it
